## Highlights

**coyotenote is now Labradorite.** New name, new logo and new default colors, and the app now starts on a simple page with a New note button.

## Moving from coyotenote

- The program is now `labradorite`, and the archive is `labradorite_v0.7.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz`. The repository moved to [eg36/Labradorite](https://github.com/eg36/Labradorite); old links redirect.
- On its first start, Labradorite moves your notes from `~/.local/share/coyotenote-web` to `~/.local/share/labradorite`. If coyotenote is still running on that folder, stop it first; otherwise Labradorite keeps using the old folder and says so.
- Unsaved browser drafts carry over to the new folder.

## New

- A **logo**: a Labrador made of labradorite, in the sidebar, the browser tab, the installed app and the README.
- **Labradorite Dark and Light**, the default themes, take their colors from the stone: slate surfaces, blue for actions, teal for links. Your theme choice is kept.
- The app **starts on a simple page** with a New note button, and your notes in the list beside it. Reloading a page with a note open still reopens that note.
- The sidebar shows only the logo at the top; hover over it to see which folder is open.

## Downloads

One archive for **Linux amd64** holds `labradorite`, the README, the guide, the license and third-party notices. Check it against `SHA256SUMS`.

[Full changelog: v0.6.1 → v0.7.0](https://github.com/eg36/Labradorite/compare/v0.6.1...v0.7.0)
